div.head: X Atr 2
div.ab: ⁊ witena gerædnes is, þæt man rihte laga upp arære ⁊ ælce unlaga georne afylle, ⁊ þæt man læte beon æghwylcne man rihtes wyrðe.
⁊ witena gerædnes is, þæt man rihte laga upp arære ⁊ ælce unlaga georne afylle, ⁊ þæt man læte beon æghwylcne man rihtes wyrðe.
And witena gerædnes is þæt man rihte laga upp arære and ælce unlaga georne afylle, and þæt man læte beon æghwylcne man rihtes wyrðe,
Und Verordnung der Witan ist, dass man echte Rechtsordnungen aufrichte und jeden Rechtsmissbrauch eifrig abschaffe, und dass man jeden Menschen [sein] Recht geniessen lasse,
And it is the ordinance of the witan that just laws be set up and every abuse of law eagerly suppressed, and that every man be allowed to have his rights,
And the decree of the councillors is, that justice be promoted and every injustice zealously suppressed, and that every man be allowed the benefit of the law.
And the judgment of the council is that just laws be upheld and each injustice zealously eradicated, and that each person be afforded their legal rights,
